coding.note: Release report: page 3 states that model code and pre-trained checkpoints are open-sourced. Page markers, not printed page numbers, are used. Data disclosure is PARTIAL: the Pile is named, but its source proportions are not reproduced. Training compute is not disclosed; algorithmic FLOP bounds and kernel timing benchmarks are not treated as training compute. Seeds are unreported. Comparator rerunning and score provenance are NR: use of the EleutherAI harness does not explicitly establish how comparator scores were obtained. The core architecture comparison is PARTIAL because multiple design choices change together; parallel-projection ablations also change parameter counts. Theory contributions are OTHER; the generalized attention design is ARCH. Analogies and extensions to attention head patterns are not automatically treated as renames.
